summary: Support authenticated redis:// and TLS rediss:// URLs in OCPI cache configuration and reject invalid or conflicting explicit Redis settings without falling back to memory.
migration: No database or wire schema changes. Configure OCPI REDIS_URL as a secret pointing to the shared Redis used by all OCPI workers, removing REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT when using a URL. The optional host/port profile remains supported; absent Redis settings retain single-process memory mode. Empty host-profile defaults are applied by the cache factory.
